data.one_liner: Auto‑scrolling end credits widget for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides a scrollable list of arbitrary widgets that automatically scrolls over a set duration. It supports pause on touch, custom timing, styling, and callbacks when finished.
use_when: You need a cinematic credits sequence in a Flutter app
You want to use any widgets (text, images, logos) as credit items
You need pause on touch or replay functionality
avoid_when: You need complex animation beyond linear scrolling
You require integration with other animation libraries like Lottie or Rive
weaknesses: Only linear scroll, no advanced physics or custom curves beyond Curves
No built‑in support for dynamic content changes during scroll
Limited to scrolling, not other animation types
data.setup_notes: Add dependency via flutter pub add credits

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use for complex animated credits with Lottie files

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides more animation options but not dedicated to credits

data.minimal_example:
Scaffold(
  body: Credits(
    duration: const Duration(seconds: 24),
    delay: const Duration(milliseconds: 400),
    onFinished: () => debugPrint('That’s a wrap!'),
    children: const [
      Text('Made together.', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 40, color: Colors.white)),
      SizedBox(height: 32),
      FlutterLogo(size: 48),
      SizedBox(height: 32),
      Text('Thank you.', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
    ],
  ),
)
